description: This file defines a class 'ColorsRgb' that generates and renders a visual representation of RGB color gradients in a PDF using PDFsharp library. It includes methods for creating colored rectangles for different RGB components and rendering them with labels.

classes.name: ColorsRgb
classes.description: A class that creates a visual RGB color gradient snippet for PDF rendering.

methods.name: ColorsRgb
methods.description: Constructor that sets the title of the snippet to 'RGB Colors'.

methods.name: GetDeciRect
methods.description: Calculates and returns a rectangle for a given index to position color blocks.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Renders multiple color gradient boxes for different RGB components onto a PDF graphics context.
